This step declares a human handoff. When approval is required, use status handoff to create the resumable approval wait; do not use awaiting_user. After an authorized human reply, persist the actual decision according to this node's instruction with submit_step_result and advance only to an allowed next step. A completed node means its decision was processed, not that the decision was approval. If this node instructs completed after either approval or rejection, submit completed for either decision and quote it accurately; do not substitute failed merely because the human rejected. Do not end with a plain-text approval summary.
